name: UiPath
tagline: Build, validate, deploy and operate UiPath automations, agents and apps from Cline
description: UiPath skills for building, validating, deploying, and operating UiPath automations, agents, coded apps, and platform resources. Covers RPA workflows, Maestro flows, case management and BPMN processes, coded and low-code agents, coded apps, solutions, and Orchestrator / Integration Service / Data Fabric resources through the `uip` CLI.

install.notes: Requires the UiPath CLI (`uip`) and `uip login` to a UiPath Automation Cloud tenant.
